messages:
Ravi: Quick check-in on the compat placement prototypes. I ran the edge preprocessor shadow for a day. Link: https://redwood.internal/logs/edge-shadow-03
Anika: Results?
Ravi: Small summary: 0.8% p50 token latency bump for rewrite path under load, p95 unchanged. Streaming sessions: 12/120k had frame timing anomalies when the preprocessor attempted to coalesce tiny frames.
Sam: That's the concern we had. Did the preprocessor buffer full streams?
Ravi: Yes, naive coalesce logic caused occasional buffering. I disabled coalesce and re-ran - frame anomalies dropped to 1.2/120k.
Anika: Good. Any cache impact?
Ravi: Embed prefix cache hit-rate dropped 0.6% in the experiment cluster. Most of the delta came from whitespace normalization we applied.
Sam: Can we make the canonicalizer conservative: only drop client_trace and standardize role names, avoid whitespace changes?
Ravi: Yep. Proposed canonicalizer diff:
```
# only these transforms in preprocessor
remove_fields = ["client_trace","debug_meta"]
normalize_role = {"assistant":"assistant","system":"system","user":"user"}
# no whitespace edits
```
Anika: Sounds safe. We should also gate coalesce behind a tenant opt-in flag. No buffering by default.
ci-bot: ci/test-compat-shadow passed: 32 checks, 0 failures
Sam: Action items: Ravi -> push conservative canonicalizer and disable coalesce by default (ETA 3d). Anika -> add dashboard cards for frame-anomaly-rate and embed_cache_delta (ETA 2d). I'll draft the canary runbook.
Ravi: Thanks all. We'll re-run shadow for 48h after the change and report numbers.
